items.title: 68437_Charles Thompson oral history interview
items.q: But there was a student who was younger than I... His name was John Rhona Dred.

ctx.x: But there was a student who was younger than I. I was I think 16, he was 12, something like that, or 14, and he played terrific piano. This young boy, he could play like Claude Hawkins, he could play like almost anybody. His name was John Rhona Dred. The name of the band was Red Perkins, P-e-r-k-i-n-s.
